requirements.evidence: Config key added (config/services.php:40 'mention_id' => env('DISCORD_MENTION_ID')); mention() at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:83-102 accepts int or string, trims, and validates against '/\A[0-9]{17,20}\z/D' (line 27), so @everyone, 123, embedded newlines/'>' are rejected; formatContent (lines 72-76) reserves mb_strlen("\n<@id>") from the 1800 limit and appends the suffix, so the mention survives truncation and behavior without a mention is unchanged. .env.example, devops.md and logging.md updated. Webhook no-op/redaction/logging paths untouched.

conventions.evidence: Matches sibling style (private const string pattern, PHPDoc on new private method and class docblock updated), tests-with-change, ops docs and .env.example updated as the task asks. CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] is not updated although conventions.md 'Keep docs in sync' requires it.

security.evidence: Strict anchored digit-only regex with \z and /D (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:27) after trim; non-string/non-int values return null (lines 90-92); full-width digits rejected since [0-9] is ASCII without /u. Existing redaction and URL-free failure logging untouched.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:125-166 cover: trimmed string id on its own last line, integer id, a dataset of null/''/@everyone/@here/abc/123/"123\n@everyone"/"123> \n@everyone"/21 digits/full-width digits asserting no '<@', and truncation to exactly 1800 with and without mention. Existing tests not modified.

simplicity.evidence: One small private helper mention() and three lines in formatContent ('$suffix = $mention === null ? '' : "\n".$mention;'); reuses existing MaxContentLength and config().

readability.evidence: Clear names (SnowflakePattern, mention(), $suffix, $limit), short focused method with docblock; no dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: All edited files (.env.example, DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/devops.md, docs/ops/logging.md, the test file) directly serve the task; no unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: Conventions require a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] for changes, and the new DISCORD_MENTION_ID feature is not recorded there.
The /D modifier is redundant when the pattern already ends with \z; harmless but slightly noisy.

review.summary: The change adds an optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID setting, validates it strictly as a 17-20 digit snowflake, appends `<@id>` on its own line while reserving room within the 1800-character limit, and documents it in .env.example and the ops docs. Tests thoroughly cover valid, invalid/abusive and truncation cases. Only a missing CHANGELOG entry keeps it from a clean approve.
